text:
maria: Heads up — after merge r3245 we're seeing +18% p95 latency on INT8 profiles on main canary. Repro on canary-3. Perf test shows 42ms -> 50ms for decode path when KV prefetch is enabled. CI perf job failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/quant-perf/782

devin: ack. any flamegraphs? logs?

maria: pasted partial perf flame (from top):
```
decode_hotloop 60%
kv_fetcher_prefetch 22%
dequantize 10%
others 8%
```
Also trace shows spike only when seq_len=2048 and cache_miss rate >30%.

samir: interesting. prefetcher change in r3245 altered batching windows — could over-eager prefetch cause extra memcpy? I remember we added contiguous copy for INT8.

maria: I bisected locally, narrowed to r3245 -> patch 7/7 (kv prefetch heuristics). Running bisect on CI now. @ci-bot can you run perf/quant-suite on canary with prefetch off vs on?

ci-bot: queued perf/quant-suite (canary-3) with env PREFETCH=0 and PREFETCH=1. ETA ~ 28m :hourglass:

jules: if we confirm, might be safer to roll back heuristic change and ship a fix to avoid memcpy when kv chunking aligned.

devin: quick repro command:
```
PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k quant_perf::long_seq' ./scripts/run_perf.sh --model llama-13b --profile int8 --seq 2048 --runs 30
```
I can repro locally with docker image redwood/runtime:canary-rc.

samir: also capture nvprof/hs_err? Could be kernel fallback due to unaligned buffers. I've seen memcpy spike show as CPU time if DMA not used.

maria: CI results: PREFETCH=1 p95 51ms, PREFETCH=0 p95 43ms. Confirmed regression is tied to prefetch on INT8.

devin: OK bisect shows commit 6c9f8a4 touched prefetch window logic. I'll open a revert PR with test and switch canary hold.

jules: +1 put canary hold and add tweak to avoid prefetch for small KV segments until we validate alignment.

maria: added rollout hold on canary. Reverting now: r3250 (revert 6c9f8a4). CI run for revert in progress.

perf: note for postmortem — add microbenchmark for KV alignment cases and an op-level counter for memcpy bytes to detect regressions earlier.

maria: filing follow-up ticket with perf traces, bisect steps, CI links, and suggested unit test. Thanks all :clap:

samir: nice work. once revert lands we'll re-run int8 perf-suite and then reintroduce heuristic with alignment checks.

ci-bot: revert PR merge succeeded. perf/quant-suite queued. status: ok

maria: latest canary perf back to baseline p95 43ms. closing thread. :tada:
